_comment: Armorsmithing Bench recipes. Tier-unlocked recipes consuming Wolf Pelt, Spider Silk, and other crafting materials.

recipes.name: Leather Cap
recipes.description: Craft a lightweight protective cap from cured wolf pelts.

recipes.name: Leather Armor
recipes.description: Craft a sturdy chestpiece from stitched wolf pelts.

recipes.name: Silk Cowl
recipes.description: Weave lightweight spider silk into a protective cowl with leather trimming.

recipes.name: Silk Robe
recipes.description: Weave a dense vestment of spider silk backed by supple wolf hide.

recipes.name: Bone Necklace
recipes.description: Strung monster bones threaded with a resilient bowstring into a protective talisman.

recipes.name: Wolf Claw Ring
recipes.description: Carve and bind beast claws and bone into a ring of endurance.

recipes.name: Venom Charm
recipes.description: Stabilize spider venom within an intricate silk weave to craft a protective ward.

recipes.name: Voidforged Greathelm
recipes.description: Hammer dense void plate into an impenetrable greathelm that deflects mortal blows.

recipes.name: Voidforged Plate Armor
recipes.description: Forge an impenetrable heavy void cuirass radiating otherworldly defensive power.

recipes.name: Voidforged Pendant
recipes.description: Suspend concentrated void essence within an intricate bone weave to project a defensive ward.

recipes.name: Voidforged Band
recipes.description: Infuse a beast-claw and steel band with void essence to reinforce physical endurance.

recipes.name: Voidforged Relic
recipes.description: Encase a legendary void core in woven subterranean silk, anchoring massive extra carry capacity and health.
